name: PhD in Biological Sciences
detailsNote: The December 1 fall deadline is published without a year, so it is not confirmed for Fall 2027. Official pages do not state the fee amount, rotations or how students are admitted, so those are left out.
summary: PhD in biological sciences at the University of Notre Dame's College of Science, with a wide choice of faculty advisors.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: The Graduate School program listing gives no year. Confirm the Fall 2027 date.

english.toefl: 80 minimum overall with at least 23 on speaking (before February 2026 scoring); 4.5 average with no section lower than 4.0 (updated scoring)
english.note: Graduate School minimums; some programs may require higher scores. Waived for native English speakers and for applicants who earned a bachelor's or higher degree at an institution where English is the language of instruction.

documents: Unofficial transcript for each post-secondary institution
requirements.note: The Graduate School says it may grant application fee waivers for a variety of reasons; the fee amount is not stated on the pages checked.

funding.note: Graduate School: almost 100% of doctoral students receive full-tuition scholarships and 94% receive multi-year fellowships or assistantships with stipends; funding is not guaranteed. 2026-27 science stipends start at $40,590 on a twelve-month basis, per its funding page. Not stated whether international students are covered.
